title: AI Security Engineer Foundations + Certificate — Javier Garza, Snyk
talk_summary: A Snyk developer advocate runs through OWASP LLM Top 10, AI threat modeling, MCP/skill supply-chain risks, and 'secure vibe coding' guardrails.

takeaways.what_they_do: Wire an agent hook so that after any code generation, a security scanner runs; if findings appear, the agent fixes and rescans, repeating until clean.
takeaways.evidence_quote: use a security tool to scan the code for vulnerabilities and if you find something, use another tool to fix it ... rinse and repeat

takeaways.what_they_do: Force verbose logging of everything an agent does to a file, then run a background scanner over the log to flag malicious/unwanted actions the UI hides.
takeaways.evidence_quote: put verbose login into a file whenever of your agentic tool of use because the tools they do a lot of things on the background

takeaways.what_they_do: Give agents only the minimum access needed; expose DB data via read-only views with only required columns rather than full DB access.
takeaways.evidence_quote: instead of giving access the agent to the whole um database ... create a view that only has these two fields

takeaways.what_they_do: Generate a machine-readable inventory (CycloneDX) of models, datasets, MCP servers, and agents per repo, then query it to find what a new CVE/zero-day impacts.
takeaways.evidence_quote: there's a zero day for um a specific model or a specific data set or a specific MCP tool you can really quickly go through everything

takeaways.what_they_do: Instead of 'build a login page', prompts enumerate required controls (rate limiting, parameterized queries, etc.) so generated code is secure by default.
takeaways.evidence_quote: you need to do a little bit more and tell basically all the things that the agent should do

takeaways.what_they_do: Treat downloaded skills and MCP servers as untrusted code: scan for malware/tool-poisoning before first run and re-scan on updates.
takeaways.evidence_quote: 367 out of 10,000 were um had some kind of malware
